Question: What does it mean to be emotionally mature?
Answer: I wanted some white shoes for a really long time. So I went from Shop to shop with my mumma to get the exact one I needed. I didn't get those same shoes but I got somewhat similar once. And I liked them. Like really really liked them. So I bought them. Cut to the next morning, one of my cousin show those shoes and said those are 'chapri shoes’. The moment he said those words, I looked at my shoes and now I wasn't sure if I like them anymore. Then, in the evening I had to go somewhere and my mumma noticed that I wasn't wearing my new white shoes. Mumma — wear your new shoes. Me — no. Mumma — why? Me — I don't feel like wearing them. Mumma — and why it that. This is a trait of Indian parents that they will get to the root of the problem anyhow. They will bombard you with so many questions that you have to come clean with them 😅. Me — I don't like them. Mumma — but you liked them so much yesterday. You were so eager to buy them. You have been begging for those shoes for months and now All of a sudden you don't like them. Why is that? Then I told her what my cousin said and stuff. Mumma — this is the clear example of weak mentality and the lowest level of immaturity. I didn't rise you to be this immature. You still like those shoes but just because some random person came and said something about your liking, you changed your likings. What sort of stupidity is this? Why are you giving someone that Power over you that they can change your opinion any second they want. And whose validation are you looking for? If you like something, you like something. Why does this has to matter to you that some other person find it 'chapri’. If you are this weak how could I trust you to survive in world. When this long lacture end, I stare at my mom for solid two minutes and ask myself if she is the same person who always says — 4 log kya kahenge. ( What will people say) Mumma — what? Me — nothing, where are my new white shoes. After this conversation I realised that — 👆👆👆👆👆 These are the traits of emotionally mature people. I am not there yet but I am getting there. Hope you do too. . . . Ho! I forgot one point…… Evara 🌻
